MR Safety
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Quartz Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
· Static magnetic field of 1.5T only
· Maximum gradient slew rate of 100 T/m/s per axis
· Maximum whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1-W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
· Use the body transmit coil
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Quartz Aneurysm Clip is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.1 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
